Create the three items

What you get: Each item inherits its group's defaults and its site row shows the intended role.

Not walked yet
Common
Procurement
Manufacturing
Warehousing

Task 6 of 11 in Create test items · next: Build the job shop bill of material

Before you start. You need step 2 of Confirm the test design.

Screen Master Data➔Items➔Items

Walk itone step at a time · 11 steps

Steps

> Note > All three items were created this way on 2026-08-16 and their site rows verified. Create the two purchased items first and the pair last, and do not create the pair until Configure the made group has approved Production and Sales defaults. Not documented for this release.

> Note > The Item identifier has separate Project and Item portions. These are standard test items: leave Project blank and enter the BAM-* code in the Item portion. If General Projects tcmcs0152s000 opens from the Project lookup, close it without creating a project.

  1. Open Items
    You should see The global item overview opens
  2. Select New
    You should see A blank Item record opens
  3. With Project blank, enter the item's code in the Item portion and its Description
    You should see item code
  4. Set Item Type to Product and Item Group to the item's group from Create two item groups
    You should see Supply source, Unit Set, and Inventory Unit default from Configure the purchased group or 3
  5. Complete any remaining field the screen marks required, using the family values
    You should see item Grade, if the screen requires one — the 2026-08-16 walk recorded Grade = FAS for all three items
  6. Save the item header before working in the Sites grid
    You should see The item header is saved
  7. In the Sites grid, ignore the editable filter row marked with =

    If no saved row begins with the site from Confirm the test design, step 2, run Create Items by Site from the tab's appropriate menu; if that produces nothing, select New on the Sites toolbar, select that site, and save the record

    You should see A saved site line beginning with the actual site code exists
  8. Select the saved site line and open it with the row-arrow button
    You should see Items by Site opens for this item and site
  9. Verify Default Supply Source matches the item's role

    Purchase for the rod and the sleeve, Job Shop for the pair

    You should see site supply source
  10. Verify the site subentity indicators

    Ordering, Purchase, and Warehousing for a purchased item; Ordering, Production, Warehousing, and Sales for the pair

    You should see site subentities
  11. Repeat steps 2–10 for the remaining items, each with its own group
    You should see All three items and their site rows match the family sheet §1

  • On save, LN gives the new item the supply source, units and subentities its group's defaults promised and, if the Sites box was set, a site row. The saved site row is where the promise is checked: the supply source and the indicators on it prove phases 2 to 4, which is why nothing inheritable is typed here.

    • The item code is rejected

      Follow the current item-code segmentation; do not modify segmentation for the experiment

    • The save is refused for a field this walkthrough does not name

      Record the field label and the message. Do not clear another value to force the save — the 2026-08-16 run found Grade this way

    • A subentity is missing after save

      Recheck Configure the purchased group for a purchased item, Configure the made group for the pair, and Verify site creation control for both

    • Actual supply differs from the default

      Check for item-level overrides and date-effective supply source before changing the default

    • Items only

      Stop after this task. The family exists as master data but cannot be produced; phases 6–10 are what make it runnable

    • Screen

      Items tcibd0501m000
      Maintains global item data at the company level — the centrally controlled item record and its subentities.
